title: Reduce Yourself To Your First Name
paragraphs: Okay. The more effective you are, the fewer titles you need. Write that down. An effective person doesn't need titles. Nelson Mandela is a name enough. That is why not all the great figures in the Bible have titles. We don't even call them by their nicknames. Doctor, priest, Bishop Moses. No, only Moses. What's your problem? You don't say, you know, Archdeacon Joshua. No, just Joshua. Do you know why you need titles? Because you are not doing anything. That's a problem. I mean, look at the Bible.

He says: " Daniel said." As you know, Malachi. Micah. Nahum, Jeremiah, Ezekiel, Daniel, Hosea, Joel. Imagine calling out to King David, David. What is your problem? I like this example more than any other. Jesus. When you are effective in life, you reduce yourself to your first name. Think about it. Paul. Paul only. Peter. The bishop is not Pope Peter. Only Peter. I told my wife years ago, I told her, "When I die, if you live long enough, put just one name on my tombstone. Miles. Let future generations come.

Because if my life isn't big enough to define that one word for children yet unborn, then I've failed." Live until your first name is enough. Write that down. Live in a way that makes your first name sum up your life. May God forgive us. Everyone wants to be a bishop. Archbishop. The chief archbishop. And I go around among these people, and I tell you that they do nothing. This man is a bishop. He doesn't even own a church. I wonder, how did you become a bishop, man? Another man, a bishop.

He has four members: his wife, his cousin, and his two nephews. Which bishop is this, man? What are you talking about? He says: I am a messenger. messenger? And you have 15 people in a small shop, man. They are sick. My name is the prophetess Sarah. Prophetess Sarah? You need a priest to seat you and make you serve in the children's department for the next four years. You are not a prophetess. Let me step back a little. Some of you are starting to feel resentful towards me here. Let everyone say " sovereignty".
Say it out loud. They shook the ceiling.
